newsitem.title: USA: Denton County, Texas, won by Service Asset Management. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Denton County, Texas, won by Service Asset Management. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects Headline ant the text to show that it was won by Service Asset Management and not A.G. Edwards & Sons, Inc.)
Service Asset Management said it won $1.480 million of Denton County, Texas, permanent improvement limited tax bonds, Series 1997, with a net interest cost of 5.3355 (corrects from 5.425) percent.
